title: DCLab Code's records kept by their own keeper: this repository's sessions only, redacted, the owner's machine only
request: Fix the 3 gaps first: the plan approval card, records into R&D's training store, and worktrees for parallel sessions.
plan: Read how the store finds sources: keepers claim a kind and a source prefix; the agents keeper (32.7) keeps this repository's Claude Code transcripts, worktrees under .claude/worktrees included.
Add a keeper for DCLab Code's own records (what the SDK transcripts lack: permissions, guard asks, answers, plan approvals) mirroring 32.7's rules.
Test it on a scratch store; extend the store check with a planted key.

decisions.decision: A keeper of its own, claim agents/dclab_code/, not files dropped into Claude Code's projects folder
decisions.why: The agents keeper's sources are Claude Code's; dropping files there would mislabel them and couple to its internals.
The agents keeper already keeps transcripts of sessions there, so own-copy sessions are kept with no other change.

decisions.decision: Only sessions on this repository are kept; others counted (name, size, sha256)
decisions.why: 32.7 keeps only this repository's sessions; CLAUDE.md: the main product is never copied here; a client's rows must not reach dclab-records.
No set builder reads these lines; a builder that does must key a session by sdkSessionId so it never lands in two splits beside its Claude Code transcript.

change: dclab_rnd/store/keepers/dclab_code.py (new), standard.install registers it; shapers label dclab_code lines; tests/test_store_dclab_code.py; store check plants a key in a record; run_parallel sets DCLAB_STORE_DCLAB_CODE=off; test_store_keepers' worker test turns both switches off; STORING_PHASE_PLAN 32.33.

findings.defect: sessions on other folders were kept whole
findings.scenario: a DCLab Code session on ../DCLab or a client's folder: its tool outputs (file contents, rows) kept as train in workspace rnd and pushed to dclab-records
findings.cause: the keeper read every record, not only this repository's
findings.fix: read sessions.json; keep a record only when its projectPath is this checkout or inside it; count the rest; keep only those rows of the index
findings.impact: a session on the main product or a client folder would put its file contents and rows into the private records repository as training data
alternatives: keep everything (the owner wants all data): set aside, the main product is never copied here and a client gave no yes

findings.defect: package id 32.32 was already taken (each person's account)
findings.scenario: the dev record and status line would merge two packages
findings.cause: the plan's Order line stopped at 32.31
findings.fix: renumbered to 32.33 everywhere; Order line extended

findings.defect: shaped lines labelled agent claude_code, and the keeper claimed to feed four models that no builder reads
findings.scenario: every shaped DCLab Code line said claude_code; trajectories() built 0
findings.cause: shapers label every agents line as Claude Code's; the record wraps SDK messages in message
findings.fix: label dclab_code for dclab_code/ sources; feeds ()

findings.defect: a test could read the real ~/.dclab-code
findings.cause: its env named no folders and no switch was set
findings.fix: the tests' switch (DCLAB_STORE_CLAUDE_PROJECTS=off) wins in home_folder; run_parallel sets DCLAB_STORE_DCLAB_CODE=off; the worker test turns both off

findings.defect: no dev record, no store-check extension
findings.fix: this record; the store check plants a key in a DCLab Code record and an other-folder session

measurements.name: the store tests for keepers
measurements.gate: every store keeper test passes, the new file's five included
limits: the daytime rule: only the relevant test files, not the full gate

measurements.name: the store check (32.18) with DCLab Code records
measurements.gate: all checks pass, a planted key is found nowhere in raw or records
measurements.result: 28 of 28: a session on this repository kept, another folder's only counted, no planted key
limits: a scratch store, not the owner's

outcome: DCLab Code's records of sessions on this repository reach the store redacted; other folders' sessions are counted only.
lessons: A keeper for another tool's data inherits the scope rule of its nearest keeper: this repository only.
Check a package number against the plan's sections, not only its Order line.
risks: sessions.json is the only link from a record to its project: a record missing from it is counted, never kept.
Nothing feeds a model until a builder reads these records.
